title: Exposing Internal Types
goal: Re-export a deeply nested struct so main can access it.
hints: Plain use statements bring items into scope privately.
Re-export the type at the storage module root so main can reference it directly.
explanation: `pub use` re-exports `Db` at the root of `storage`, allowing `main` to reach `storage::Db`. A plain `use` imports `Db` privately inside `storage`, causing error `E0603` when accessed from outside. Calling `storage::engine::Db` fails because module `engine` is private inside `storage`.
